scripts.name: arrayjobsubmission.sh
scripts.purpose: Generates a chain of restart input files and SLURM submission scripts for a sequence of CP3D DNS jobs, incrementing iteration/restart-time windows each loop.
scripts.usage: edit numberOfJobs/siminterval/casename etc at top, run in case directory; sbatch calls commented out by default.

scripts.name: checkfiles.sh
scripts.purpose: Verifies presence of expected velocity field binary output files (vex/vey/vez) over a numbered range to spot missing/incomplete output.
scripts.usage: edit start/end/interval at top, run from case dir (expects data/ subfolder).
scripts.note: same template as dopamine/checkfiles.sh, different file-naming convention — dup.

scripts.name: ffmpeg_makemovies.sh
scripts.purpose: Reference cookbook of ffmpeg one-liners (renaming, movie from image sequence, slow-motion, stacking, GIF) — not meant to run top-to-bottom.
scripts.usage: copy/paste individual commands as needed, edit filenames per use.

scripts.name: generateCopyList.sh
scripts.purpose: Prints the list of vex/vey/vez filenames for a given index range, for building a copy/rsync file list.
scripts.usage: edit st/en/inter at top, run and redirect stdout.

scripts.name: job_array_submission.sh
scripts.purpose: Generates and submits a chain of dependent CaNS DNS jobs, incrementing end-iteration each loop, with restart flag toggling.
scripts.usage: edit numberOfJobs/startValue/siminterval/casename/orgslurmfilename at top, run in case dir.

scripts.name: jobarraysubmission_synthetic_snellius.sh
scripts.purpose: Generates and submits a chain of dependent CaNS jobs with synthetic initial condition support and scratch-space staging via rsync (Snellius).
scripts.usage: edit config vars at top, run in case dir.
scripts.note: more advanced version of job_array_submission.sh — dup.

scripts.name: convert_highres2lowred.sh
scripts.purpose: Converts/downsamples an image (e.g. high-res PDF) to a lower-quality output using ImageMagick.
scripts.usage: ./convert_highres2lowred.sh <density> <input_file> <quality> <output_file>

scripts.name: create_randomuserpass.py
scripts.purpose: Generates a list of funny random usernames with random passwords, printed to stdout.
scripts.usage: python3 create_randomuserpass.py; edit num_users in-script to change count.

scripts.name: create_users.sh
scripts.purpose: Bulk-creates Linux system users (with group, shell, disk quota, OpenFOAM env setup) from a username/password file, or previews them in test mode.
scripts.usage: edit config vars at top, then sudo ./create_users.sh; reads users.txt (username/password pairs) in cwd.
scripts.note: expects plaintext users.txt and echoes passwords in test mode - lab-only, never commit users.txt.

scripts.name: generate_qrcode.py
scripts.purpose: Prompts for a URL and generates/saves a QR code image for it.
scripts.usage: python3 generate_qrcode.py, then enter link at prompt; outputs qrcode.png.

scripts.name: generate_users.py
scripts.purpose: Generates a list of funny random usernames with random passwords, printed to stdout.
scripts.usage: python3 generate_users.py; edit num_users (default 12) to change count.
scripts.note: duplicate/near-duplicate of create_randomuserpass.py - dup; likely the input generator for create_users.sh's users.txt.

scripts.name: merry_christmas.sh
scripts.purpose: Prints an animated, colorized ASCII Christmas tree with a custom message in the terminal.
scripts.usage: ./merry_christmas.sh [interval] [message] (both optional); Ctrl+C to exit.

scripts.name: consolidate_snapshots.sh
scripts.purpose: Merges scattered fieldsN/duct0.f* checkpoint directories into one fields/ directory with sequential numbering.
scripts.usage: run once in a Nek5000 case directory after multiple job runs.

scripts.name: delftblue_submit.sh
scripts.purpose: SLURM batch script that runs one Nek5000 job in a chained sequence: restores latest checkpoint, runs nek5000, archives new checkpoints.
scripts.usage: submitted via sbatch with --job-name="N_casename"; expects inputFiles/<N>_duct.par to exist.

scripts.name: dependency_array_submission.sh
scripts.purpose: Driver that prepares and submits a chain of dependent Nek5000 jobs, writing per-job .par files and submitting via SLURM dependency chain.
scripts.usage: edit numberOfJobs/startValue/siminterval/casename/nekcase/parfile at top, run in case dir; submit_jobs toggle for dry-run.

scripts.name: RANS_OF_Parallel_Base_Script.sh
scripts.purpose: SLURM job that decomposes, runs simpleFoam in parallel, and reconstructs one OpenFOAM case (1st order).
scripts.usage: sbatch RANS_OF_Parallel_Base_Script.sh; edit nProcs/simEndTime inline.

scripts.name: chainsubmission.sh
scripts.purpose: Generates and submits SLURM job scripts in N parallel dependency chains for a runtype x angle x mesh sweep.
scripts.usage: ./chainsubmission.sh [--dry-run]; needs template.slurm in cwd.

scripts.name: clear_decomposefiles.sh
scripts.purpose: Removes processor* decomposition folders from a range of numbered case directories.
scripts.usage: edit startAngle/interval/endAngle inline, run directly.

scripts.name: clusterScaling.py
scripts.purpose: Plots parallel scaling (speedup/efficiency) from per-core-count timing logs (cpuN.dat files).
scripts.usage: run as script in dir containing cpuN.dat files.

scripts.name: convert_vtk2binary.py
scripts.purpose: Converts VTK cutting-plane U/k fields to flat binary files per height/angle (local cluster layout).
scripts.usage: edit casename/paths inline, run as script.
scripts.note: near-duplicate of convert_vtk2binary_snellius.py — dup, differs in source path layout and z-levels.

scripts.name: convert_vtk2binary_snellius.py
scripts.purpose: Same VTK-to-binary conversion but for Snellius HPC directory layout, with a pre-flight file-existence check.
scripts.usage: edit vars inline, run as script.

scripts.name: copy_files_within_HPC.sh
scripts.purpose: rsyncs simulation output field folder and run.log from numbered case dirs to a group storage location (intra-HPC).
scripts.usage: edit startindex/endindex/location inline.

scripts.name: copy_filesfromHPC.sh
scripts.purpose: rsyncs simulation result folders from a remote HPC (via ssh alias) to local fields_<angle> dirs.
scripts.usage: edit startAngle/endAngle/location inline.

scripts.name: copyfiles4riskmap.sh
scripts.purpose: Copies U/k result fields into numbered dirs for risk-map post-processing.
scripts.usage: edit simEndTime/startAngle/endAngle inline.

scripts.name: delft_blue_1st_order.sh
scripts.purpose: SLURM job running a full sweep of angles, 1st-order simpleFoam, sequentially (decompose, run, reconstruct, move).
scripts.usage: sbatch delft_blue_1st_order.sh; edit startAngle/interval/endAngle.
scripts.note: pairs with delft_blue_2nd_order.sh — dup-cluster with other submit_* scripts.

scripts.name: delft_blue_2nd_order.sh
scripts.purpose: SLURM job running a sweep of angles, 2nd-order simpleFoam, restarting from prior 1st-order results.
scripts.usage: sbatch delft_blue_2nd_order.sh; edit params inline.

scripts.name: fetch_allresiduals.sh
scripts.purpose: Extracts solver residuals (p, U, k, epsilon) from per-case run.log files across numbered folders.
scripts.usage: edit startindex/endindex/logfile inline, run in results dir.
scripts.note: near-duplicate of getResiduals.sh and functions.sh's getlogdata() — dup.

scripts.name: first_order_specifiedarray.sh
scripts.purpose: SLURM job running 1st-order simpleFoam only for an explicit hand-picked list of angles.
scripts.usage: sbatch first_order_specifiedarray.sh; edit simangles array.

scripts.name: functions.py
scripts.purpose: Shared Python helper library for point sampling, mesh/point plotting, OBJ loading, OpenFOAM probe reading, plot styling.
scripts.usage: import via 'from functions import ...'.

scripts.name: functions.sh
scripts.purpose: Shared bash helper library defining getlogdata() to extract solver residuals from a log file.
scripts.usage: source functions.sh, then call getlogdata logfile prefix.
scripts.note: canonical version of residual-extraction logic duplicated in fetch_allresiduals.sh/getResiduals.sh — dup.

scripts.name: generateAllCases_1st_order.sh
scripts.purpose: Creates per-angle case directories from an orgCase/ template, edits ABLConditions + job name, copies files (does not submit).
scripts.usage: edit startAngle/interval/endAngle, run in dir containing orgCase/.

scripts.name: generateAllCases_2nd_order.sh
scripts.purpose: Same as generateAllCases_1st_order.sh but also copies prior 1st-order results for restart.
scripts.usage: edit params, run in dir with orgCase/ and resultsLocation.

scripts.name: generate_and_submit.sh
scripts.purpose: Creates per-angle case dirs from orgCase/, edits ABLConditions + job name, and submits each via sbatch.
scripts.usage: edit startAngle/endAngle, run in dir with orgCase/submit.sh.

scripts.name: generate_samplingPoints.py
scripts.purpose: Generates/loads uniformly distributed 3D sampling points within a bounding box and plots them against a building mesh.
scripts.usage: run as script; edit ximin/ximax/obj_file_path/flags inline.

scripts.name: getResiduals.sh
scripts.purpose: Loops over numbered case folders extracting residuals from run.log via inline getlogdata function.
scripts.usage: edit startindex/endindex, run in results dir.

scripts.name: latin_hypercube_sampling.py
scripts.purpose: Generates Latin Hypercube samples of wind direction from historical wind data via inverse-CDF sampling.
scripts.usage: run as script; edit n_samples/wind_datafilename inline.

scripts.name: lhs_mda_2d_comparison.py
scripts.purpose: Compares 2D (direction+speed) LHS sampling vs Maximum Dissimilarity Algorithm sampling from joint wind PDF.
scripts.usage: run as script; edit n_samples/wind_datafilename inline.

scripts.name: map_solutions.sh
scripts.purpose: Maps a converged solution's turbulence fields from a source case into a target case's processor dirs for warm-starting a new inflow direction.
scripts.usage: ./map_solutions.sh /path/source /path/target.

scripts.name: movefiles.sh
scripts.purpose: Moves individual field files into a time-stamped subfolder per angle.
scripts.usage: edit startAngle/interval/endAngle inline.

scripts.name: pedestrian_wind_comfort.py
scripts.purpose: Computes NEN8100 pedestrian wind comfort class probabilities from simulated wind-speed binaries and historical wind data.
scripts.usage: run as script; edit wind_step/paths/z_comfort/thresholds inline.

scripts.name: postProcess.sh
scripts.purpose: Runs OpenFOAM postProcess (simpleFoam -postProcess -latestTime) across a sweep of angle case results.
scripts.usage: edit simEndTime/startAngle/endAngle/interval; run in case dir.

scripts.name: runAllGeometryPrepAndMesh.sh
scripts.purpose: Generates cube geometry via gmsh, builds STL, runs surfaceFeatures/blockMesh/snappyHexMesh (serial).
scripts.usage: ./runAllGeometryPrepAndMesh.sh from case root.

scripts.name: runAllGeometryPrep_TUDcampus.sh
scripts.purpose: Copies 4 OBJ meshes, runs surfaceFeatures/blockMesh, then snappyHexMesh (parallel or serial), reconstructs and checks mesh.
scripts.usage: ./runAllGeometryPrep_TUDcampus.sh; edit nprocs/snapPar.

scripts.name: runFoamCase_varyUtauZrefplus.sh
scripts.purpose: Runs a parameter sweep of simpleFoam cases varying inlet friction velocity and zplusref via ABLConditions edits.
scripts.usage: ./runFoamCase_varyUtauZrefplus.sh; edit nprocs/totalIterations/utauarray/zplusref arrays.

scripts.name: runalldegrees.sh
scripts.purpose: Local (non-SLURM) sweep runner over wind angles: edits ABLConditions, decompose/run/reconstruct/move per angle.
scripts.usage: ./runalldegrees.sh; edit nProcs/startAngle/endAngle/interval.

scripts.name: submit_1storder.sh
scripts.purpose: SLURM job that decomposes/runs(1st order)/reconstructs a single pre-set-up case.
scripts.usage: sbatch submit_1storder.sh; edit SBATCH header + nProcs/simEndTime.
scripts.note: near-identical to RANS_OF_Parallel_Base_Script.sh and submit_2ndorder.sh — dup.

scripts.name: submit_2ndorder.sh
scripts.purpose: Same as submit_1storder.sh but for 2nd-order scheme, longer simEndTime.
scripts.usage: sbatch submit_2ndorder.sh.

scripts.name: submit_parallelruns.sh
scripts.purpose: Generic/templated SLURM job script with placeholder account/partition/OpenFOAM path values.
scripts.usage: sbatch submit_parallelruns.sh after filling in placeholders.
scripts.note: sanitized template version of submit_1storder.sh — dup.

scripts.name: terrain_gpkg_to_stl.py
scripts.purpose: Converts a GeoPackage point-cloud terrain into a triangulated STL surface for OpenFOAM.
scripts.usage: python terrain_gpkg_to_stl.py; edit filepath/z_offset inline.

scripts.name: checkfiles.sh
scripts.purpose: Verifies presence of expected Nek5000-style field output files (fields/channel_test.$num) over a numbered range.
scripts.usage: edit start/end/interval at top, run in case dir.
scripts.note: same template as CaNS/checkfiles.sh, single-file-per-step naming — dup.

scripts.name: genCopyList.sh
scripts.purpose: Prints filenames (fields/channel_test.$num) for a given index range, for building copy/rsync lists.
scripts.usage: edit st/en/inter at top, run and redirect output.

scripts.name: generateMultipleSDF.sh
scripts.purpose: Batch-generates signed distance fields for a building geometry at multiple rotation angles, converts output to CaNS array format, archives results per angle.
scripts.usage: run in the stl2sdf project dir; edit runmat array of angles.

scripts.name: chunked_driver_animation.py
scripts.purpose: Memory-efficient variant of the driver-file reader, same DriverFileReader API but with lazy/chunked/streaming reads for large datasets.
scripts.usage: run directly; edit USER INPUT PARAMETERS in __main__.

scripts.name: functions.py
scripts.purpose: Shared helper library for grid generation (tanh/geometric stretching), grid plotting, OBJ geometry merge/clip/rotate, processor decomposition.
scripts.usage: import via 'from functions import gen_grid, round_to_multiple, plot_grid, get_decomp, getN'.

scripts.name: gen_cases_pre_calculated_pre_processing.sh
scripts.purpose: Generates numbered experiment directories for multiple wind angles, copying pre-computed geometry/IBM data and submit scripts.
scripts.usage: edit angles/geo_location/geo_prefix/ibm_prefix/submit_jobs vars, run ./gen_cases_pre_calculated_pre_processing.sh.
scripts.note: near-duplicate of gen_submit_multiple_cases.sh — dup, assumes IBM pre-processing already done

scripts.name: gen_submit_multiple_cases.sh
scripts.purpose: Generates numbered experiment directories per angle (geometry only, no IBM data), copies config/namoptions/submit, optionally submits.
scripts.usage: edit angles/driver_exp_num/exp_start_num/submit_jobs vars, run.

scripts.name: grid_calculations.py
scripts.purpose: Computes recommended domain grid (Nx, Ny, Nz), processor decomposition, and stretching parameters for a uDALES case setup.
scripts.usage: edit USER INPUT PARAMETERS block at top, run python grid_calculations.py.

scripts.name: plot_fluid_boundary_points.py
scripts.purpose: Loads fluid_boundary_c.txt (IBM fluid boundary points) and scatter-plots point locations colored by a third column.
scripts.usage: run from a directory containing fluid_boundary_c.txt.

scripts.name: pre_process_multiple.sh
scripts.purpose: Sets up experiment directories from geometry files and runs uDALES's write_inputs.sh pre-processing (facet/IBM generation) inline, waiting for completion.
scripts.usage: edit angles/geo_location/geo_prefix/exp_start_num/max_wait_time/uDALES_HOME vars, run.

scripts.name: precursor_loglaw_check.py
scripts.purpose: Computes and plots the theoretical log-law velocity profile to validate/design precursor simulation boundary conditions.
scripts.usage: edit Uref/Zref/z0/kappa/H/d constants at top, run; displays plot.

scripts.name: read_driver_files.py
scripts.purpose: DriverFileReader class reading/collating uDALES precursor driver boundary-condition binaries across processors, then plots profiles/animation.
scripts.usage: run directly; edit USER INPUT PARAMETERS in __main__ (experiment_number, nprocy, ny, nz, utau, etc).

scripts.name: read_xytdump.py
scripts.purpose: Reads a uDALES xytdump.*.nc (horizontally-averaged) netCDF output and plots streamwise velocity profiles vs height.
scripts.usage: edit filename/Uref/Zref/plot_index_start/avg_index_start at top, run.

scripts.name: submit.sh
scripts.purpose: SLURM batch script (general cluster) that loads modules, runs uDALES pre-processing with a wait/poll loop, then runs the u-dales simulation binary.
scripts.usage: sbatch submit.sh from an experiment directory.

scripts.name: submit_snellius.sh
scripts.purpose: SLURM batch script for Snellius cluster; loads Snellius modules and runs u-dales directly (no inline pre-processing/wait loop).
scripts.usage: sbatch submit_snellius.sh.
scripts.note: leaner variant of submit.sh, assumes pre-processing already done — dup

scripts.name: time_average_snapshots_multiple_experiments.py
scripts.purpose: Batch time-averages fielddump.*.nc outputs across a decomposed grid for a range of experiment numbers, in parallel.
scripts.usage: edit procx/procy/average_last_n/start_exp_num/end_exp_num/num_parallel_workers at top, run.

scripts.name: time_calculations.py
scripts.purpose: Computes precursor/driven-simulation timing parameters (friction velocity, eddy turnover time, convective time scale, precursor duration, driverstore count).
scripts.usage: edit constants at top (dtmax, Tsim, H, Lb, Uref, Zref, z0, eddy_factor), run; prints results.

scripts.name: visualise_zgrid.py
scripts.purpose: Loads a lscale.inp.<exp> vertical grid file and plots grid spacing vs height on a log scale.
scripts.usage: edit filename at top, run; displays plot.
scripts.note: overlaps with plot_grid() in functions.py — dup

scripts.name: write_uDALES_restart_file.py
scripts.purpose: uDALESRestartWriter class writing uDALES binary restart/warmstart files per processor from field-data dictionaries, e.g. to bootstrap a run from GenIC velocity slices.
scripts.usage: edit USER INPUT DATA (nx, ny, nz, exp_num, nprocx, nprocy, num_scalars) in __main__, run.
